text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty - HIGH: Service=\"inference-gateway\" triggered by increased 5xx rate in prod-us-west1. Alert window: 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC123456

pagerduty: Alert details: symptom=\"5xx-rate\" threshold=8% current=12.3% origin=gateway-proxy

sara (oncall): acked in PD. i'm on the channel. starting initial triage.

mike (infra): looking at graphs -> spike started ~10:42 UTC. 502s + 504s from gateway-proxy, downstream model-runtime showing elevated error returns.

anita (runtime): seeing a burst of KV cache evictions on kvcache-prod-01 around the same time. eviction rate up ~4x. could be causing backend latency and OOMs.

tj (eng-sre): any recent deploys?

mike (infra): there was a canary deploy to gateway-proxy tagged v2.7.0-canary at 10:35. Canary traffic ~5% by weight.

anita (runtime): that lines up. runtime logs show a pattern: backend connections to model-hosts -> \"write: broken pipe\" and OOM-ish logs on a subset of hosts.

sara (oncall): okay, plan: 1) disable canary routing to remove runway for the regression. 2) enable fallback routing to quantized model variant for noisy customers. 3) monitor 5xx for 15m. I'll coordinate.

mike (infra): running command to remove canary weight:
```
# admin route ctl
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" https://controlplane/api/routes/canary -d '{"weight":0}'
```

mike (infra): command issued, controlplane responded 200. canary weight set to 0.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: canary weight set to 0 by mike (infra). Escalation timer paused.

anita (runtime): pushing routing override to route heavy customers to model-quant-v1 for 30m:
```
POST /admin/route-override
{"selector":"customer_tier=heavy","model":"model-quant-v1","ttl":"30m"}
```

anita (runtime): override applied.

oliver (cs): i'm seeing 6 support tickets in the last 10m referencing 502s, mostly from EU customers hitting our US region via proxy. informing top-5 customers.

sara (oncall): thanks oliver. are we seeing request volume change?

mike (infra): overall QPS steady. error-percent dropping to 7.1% at 10:52 after canary removal and override. still above threshold but trending down.

anita (runtime): checking host health -> 3 model-hosts had high RSS and restarted their runtime process; autoscaler didn't spawn replacements fast enough due to placement limits. i've temporarily allowed burst nodes in zone-1 to come up (manual override).

tj (eng-sre): noted. can we add a short-term autoscale policy raise to avoid churning while we recover?

anita (runtime): yes - increased max replicas for model-pool-prod to +20% for 15m via the infra API.

mike (infra): infra change applied. new hosts provisioning.

sara (oncall): monitoring 5xx: 10:54 -> 5xx at 4.8%, latency normalized. keep watch for 15m. if stable, we'll close.

mike (infra): digging through traces: top error code is 502 with upstream \"connection reset\" from model-hosts that were restarted. looks transient.

anita (runtime): runtime logs show a GC/compaction spike on model-hosts right before restart; suspect memory growth from a small regression in kv-layer's eviction path introduced in gateway v2.7.0-canary.

sara (oncall): action items so far: canary weight removed (mike), routing override (anita), temporary autoscale bump (anita). ops visibility: mj (oncall) and tj keep watch.

tj (eng-sre): i'm leaving a runbook note: possible root cause = canary change to eviction algorithm. we should rollback gateway change and add tighter memory limits + tests.

mike (infra): rolling back the canary candidate from the release pipeline to be safe (deploy pipeline id: rel-2026-04-12-986).

mike (infra): rollback completed at 10:59.

incident-bot: PagerDuty - note: rollback executed by mike (infra).

oliver (cs): customers notified: top-5 customers emailed and CS triage thread created. responses are: some saw intermittent failures, many resumed normal behavior after ~10:55.

sara (oncall): 11:02 check: 5xx at 1.1% rolling. below alert threshold. streaming errors trending to 0.

anita (runtime): reverting autoscale bump in 10m unless we see more pressure. also will open a PR to revert eviction code path in gateway canary.

tj (eng-sre): adding follow-up: postmortem owner = anita, due EOD tomorrow. include regression test to simulate parallel kvcache eviction under heavy fanout.

mike (infra): I'll add monitoring alert to watch GC pause and RSS on model-hosts and make a dashboard for the last-mile failure mode.

sara (oncall): marking PD incident mitigated. leaving channel open for 20m to confirm stability. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty - incident INC123456 set to \"Mitigated\" by sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): final check 11:15 -> 5xx 0.2% last 10m. closing the thread. will follow up in postmortem.

oliver (cs): thx everyone. i'll summarize customer impact for postmortem: ~0.8% of global QPS affected during peak ~10:42-11:00, several support tickets, no data loss.

anita (runtime): filing PR to revert kv-eviction tweak: https://git.example/repo/pull/4321

tj (eng-sre): assigning follow-ups: anita (root cause), mike (deploy gating), tj (monitoring), oliver (customer notes).

sara (oncall): resolved. good job team. :tada:

incident-bot: Thread closed. Logs and runbook notes attached to INC123456.
